business_name: Chef Sake's Restaurant and Sushi Bar
description: Chef Sakes Restaurant and Sushi Bar focuses to serve guests with unique, fresh and flavorful dishes and everyone is welcomed as family and friends. For more than a decade, our chef, Chef Sake is a renowned sushi chef who has delivered his innovative approach to sushi making craft in Mobile. Using the very best ingredients; combined with traditional Japanese cooking techniques, makes Chef Sakes Restaurant and Sushi Bars offers flavors of authentic Japanese cuisine with a twist of fusion that has been taken to a higher level. Enjoy a glass of sake or beer that has been carefully selected to compliment the spices and sauces in Japanese cuisine. Chef Sakes Restaurant and Sushi Bar is located across from University of South Alabama campus.
